title: 2232. Minimize Result by Adding Parentheses to Expression

examples.explanation: The expression evaluates to 2 * (47 + 38) = 2 * 85 = 170. Note that "2(4)7+38" is invalid because the right parenthesis must be to the right of the '+'. It can be shown that 170 is the smallest possible value.
